description: DiligenceOps: submit a counterparty’s audit or attestation report excerpt (SOC 2, SOC 1, ISO 27001, PCI DSS or similar), as text, fields (standard, report_type, auditor, period_start, period_end, as_of, opinion, exceptions, qualifications, scope) or both, with optional context (engagement_starts, and the summary the vendor gave you). The signed report states what the report covers, the standard and type, the auditor, the period or single date, the opinion, the exceptions and the scope, and names its limits plainly: a point-in-time report presented as period coverage, exceptions left out of the summary, a period that ended before the engagement starts, a qualified opinion, carved-out subservice organizations and controls left to the user entity. POST /api/audit-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send the report, the fields or both.

context.description: Optional: when the engagement starts and how the report was summarized to you.

engagement_starts.description: Optional date your engagement with the vendor starts.

summary.description: Optional summary of the report as the vendor presented it, for example "SOC 2 Type II, no exceptions", so it can be set beside the report.

fields.description: The same material as fields. A field given here takes precedence over the document for that element.

as_of.description: The date of a point-in-time report.

auditor.description: The audit firm or certification body.

exceptions.description: The exceptions or deviations noted, or a statement that none were noted.

opinion.description: The opinion or result as written.

period_end.description: The end of the period covered.

period_start.description: The start of the period covered.

qualifications.description: Any qualification, modification or emphasis of matter.

report_type.description: The report type, for example "Type 2", "Type 1" or "certification".

scope.description: The systems, services, locations or criteria in scope.

standard.description: The standard, for example "SOC 2", "SOC 1", "ISO 27001" or "PCI DSS".

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

report.description: The audit or attestation report excerpt as text or HTML, up to 256 KB: the opinion, the description of the period or date, the testing results and any exceptions.

name: wever_audit-evidence-check
title: Audit evidence check
